name: gitguard
description: Advanced Git/GitHub repo intelligence: secret scanning, health scoring, commit quality, stale branch detection, dependency freshness, and PR/issue triage.

tools.name: scan_secrets
tools.description: Scan a repo for exposed API keys/tokens/credentials via entropy + pattern analysis.

tools.name: health_report
tools.description: Composite 0-100 repo health score across secrets, branches, commits, deps, activity.

tools.name: multi_repo_dashboard
tools.description: Rank many local repos by health score, worst first.

tools.name: commit_quality
tools.description: Conventional Commits compliance and message-quality scoring.

tools.name: dependency_check
tools.description: Check package.json/requirements.txt against live npm/PyPI registries.

tools.name: github_triage
tools.description: Fetch open PRs/issues from GitHub and flag which have gone stale.
